o.text:
Inherited from Ajami Turkic [script needed] (dışxarı) (likely influenced by Chagatai [script needed] (tašqarı)), from Old Anatolian Turkish دشره (daşra) (attested in "Destân-ı Yûsuf" in the 13th century), from Proto-Common Turkic *tašgaru.
Cognate with Turkish dışarı, Gagauz dışar, Chuvash тол (tol).
From Persian محافظهکار (mohâfeze-kâr). By surface analysis, mühafizə + -kar.
